description: Figure 1 is a bar chart titled “Average Performance and Tokens of CoUT and Baselines for 4 LRMs over 4 Benchmarks,” which visually compares the average performance and token usage of the proposed Chain of Unconscious Thought (CoUT) method against four baseline Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) across four different benchmarks. The horizontal axis lists the four benchmarks, presented in a specific order: “MATH,” “GSM8K,” “HumanEval,” and “HumanEval (Hard).” The vertical axis is a dual-axis chart: the left axis represents “Average Performance” with a scale ranging from 0 to 1.0, marked with tick labels at intervals of 0.2, and the right axis represents “Tokens” with a scale ranging from 0 to 200, marked with tick labels at intervals of 50. The chart displays grouped bars for each benchmark, with each group containing two bars: one for CoUT (colored dark blue) and one for the corresponding baseline LRM (colored light blue). For each benchmark, the CoUT bar is consistently shorter than the baseline bar, indicating lower token usage. The CoUT bars show a range of token usage from approximately 100 to 150 tokens, while the baseline bars are significantly taller, ranging from approximately 150 to 200 tokens. The performance bars (left axis) are all at or near the top of the scale, indicating high accuracy for all methods. The chart is not sorted, and the bars are presented in the order of the benchmarks listed on the horizontal axis.
